name: B10-0459/2026 (ECR) – Attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on attempts by the ruling party Georgian Dream to ban opposition parties in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Georgia's ruling party, Georgian Dream, for trying to ban opposition parties through the courts. It asks Georgia to drop the court case and scrap the law that allows party bans. It calls for the release of people it considers political prisoners. It also asks European Union countries to impose sanctions on Bidzina Ivanishvili and officials involved in political persecution.

- Nothing changes yet; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It targets Georgia's government, courts and jailed opposition figures.
- Next, European Union governments decide whether to impose the requested sanctions.
